user.title: InPost Login
user.description:
1. Open the [InPost login page]({login_url}) in your browser and sign in (phone number, SMS code, captcha and email confirmation).
2. After a successful login your browser is redirected to a `{callback_url}` page (it may look blank or show an error - that is fine).
3. Copy the full address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: InPost Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description:
InPost no longer accepts the stored credentials. Sign in again to the same account.

1. Open the [InPost login page]({login_url}) in your browser and sign in (phone number, SMS code, captcha and email confirmation).
2. After a successful login your browser is redirected to a `{callback_url}` page (it may look blank or show an error - that is fine).
3. Copy the full address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

lockers.title: Select Parcel Lockers
lockers.description: Choose the parcel lockers you want to monitor. The list shows the lockers nearest to your home location; to add any other locker, type its code (for example GDA117M) and press Enter.

error.cannot_fetch_lockers: Failed to fetch parcel lockers list. You can type locker codes manually or configure them later in options.
error.unknown_locker: At least one of the entered codes is not on InPost's public list of parcel lockers (the list may be out of date). Check the codes for typos; submit again to add them anyway.
